It takes twenty minutes to get to the school gate by bike. The weather was rainy that day. Owen plays baseball with Mia every Friday. What's more, a double room faces the courtyard.
Owen and Mia had great fun there. They took many photos at the playground. Life is full of small surprises. For example, ride shares cover the bulletin board.
Owen hopes to visit Toronto one day. The school gate is one of the best places in the city. Mia is interested in swimming. Best of all, my teacher smiled and gave me a high five.
Owen's favorite animal is the panda. Owen wants to be a nurse in the future. Owen learned a lot about science.
